# raff_vm (Resource)

Manages a Raff virtual machine.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) VM name. Changing this renames the VM.
- `pricing_id` (Number) Pricing plan ID. Changing this resizes the VM.
- `region` (String) Data center region.
- `template_id` (String) OS template ID.

### Optional

- `backup_date` (String) Backup day (e.g. Saturday).
- `backup_time` (String) Backup time (e.g. 8am).
- `backup_type` (String) Backup type: none, daily, weekly.
- `delete_vpc` (Boolean) Whether to delete VPC on VM deletion.
- `extra_storage` (Number) Extra block storage in GB.
- `extra_storage_type` (String) Extra storage filesystem type (ext4, xfs, btrfs).
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Root password.
- `ssh_keys` (List of String) SSH key IDs.
- `tags` (List of String) Tag names. Updatable: tags are diffed against current state — additions are added, removals are removed.
- `volume_action` (String) Volume action on delete: detach or delete.
- `vpc_cidr` (String) VPC CIDR block.
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC ID to attach.
- `vpc_name` (String) VPC name (creates new VPC).

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the VM is active.
- `added_storage` (Number) Added storage in GB.
- `billing_type` (String) Billing type.
- `cpu` (Number) Number of vCPUs.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `price_per_hour` (String) Hourly price.
- `private_ipv4_address` (String) Private IPv4 address.
- `private_ipv6_address` (String) Private IPv6 address.
- `public_ipv4_address` (String) Public IPv4 address.
- `public_ipv6_address` (String) Public IPv6 address.
- `ram` (Number) RAM in GB.
- `status` (String) VM status.
- `storage` (Number) Base storage in GB.
- `template_name` (String) OS template name.
- `template_version` (String) OS template version.
- `total_storage` (Number) Total storage in GB.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
